DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tear.

The onset of pain following repetitive pivoting and twisting during volleyball in a young female is highly characteristic of an ACL injury. The worsening pain over the last day suggests significant inflammation or a potential meniscal tear associated with the initial ligament injury. Given the mechanism and clinical presentation, I am confident in this diagnosis based on the available history.
